exam: 109年專門職業及技術人員高等考試大地工程技師考試分階段考試（第一階段考試）、驗船師、第一次食品技師考試、高等暨普通考試消防設備人員考試、普通考試地政士、專責報關人員、保險代理人保險經紀人及保險公證人考試、109年第一次專門職業及技術人員特種考試驗光人員考試
subject: 關務英文

essays.text:
請將下列中文名詞譯為英文：（每小題 5 分，共 20 分）
①裝貨港
②包裝材料
③運輸工具
④貨櫃號碼

請將下列各題之英文譯為中文：（每小題 15 分，共 30 分）
① At times, for determining the duty liability and permissibility of import itmay become necessary for the Customs to examine goods. Where aphysical examination of imported goods is required, the removal of goodsfor examination, unpacking, repacking, etc. is to be performed by or at theexpense of the importer. In general, the importer or his/her representativeshall be present during physical examinations.
② If the transaction value of imported goods, of identical goods, or of similargoods cannot be determined, then deductive value should be the basis ofCustoms valuation. This method is used unless the importer designatescomputed value as the preferred valuation method. Basically, deductivevalue is the resale price in the domestic market after importation of thegoods, with deductions for certain expenses.

mcq.q: When the goods are packed and ready for delivery, the exporter should find a _____ agency to arrangeshipping schedule and handle export procedures.
The duty-payer shall declare imported goods to Customs within fifteen days following the _____ date ofthe transportation means carrying such goods.
Customs shall follow the _____ of Origin on Imported Goods, when determining the origin of importedgoods.
For the necessity of suppressing smuggling, Customs may _____ the suspect, witness and other personsconcerned.
Any person who smuggles import or export cargoes shall be imposed with a _____ no more than threetimes the value of the cargoes in question.

Where a person requests exemption, reduction or drawback of duties by any undue way, a fine no morethan five times the duties _____ or rebated shall be imposed, and the cargoes concerned may beconfiscated.
All logistics centers shall take a regular ____ at least once a year.
The duty-payers concerned may make online declarations by way of electronic data transmission _____to the importation so as to enjoy expedited Customs clearance procedures.
A Customs broker receiving a Customs clearance processing assignment from an importer or exporter isrequired to present a power of _____ establishing such appointment.
The bonded warehouses may be used for the storage of _____.
opts: goods for sale in duty-free shops
animals, plants or their products that fail to pass the quarantine inspection

mcq.q: The supervising Customs offices may assign Customs officers to conduct periodic or unscheduled _____of the bonded goods stored in bonded warehouses.

The rate of the Nomenclature of Customs Import Tariff is divided into three columns. The first columnapplies to goods imported from WTO members or from countries or areas that have _____ treatment withthe Republic of China.
After an import _____ of goods has been submitted to the Customs, a duty-payer may proceed with pre-entry declaration to the Customs for goods imported by submitting all required documentation.
Under the method of first-come first-serve, the tariff rate quota shall be allocated by the order of the dateof _____.
All anti-dumping duty shall remain in force only as long as and to the extent necessary to counteractdumping which is causing _____.
Customs may provide _____ measures for goods imported or exported by the Authorized EconomicOperators.

The Customs value of imported goods shall be the _____ value, that is the price actually paid or payablefor the goods when sold for export to the country of importation adjusted in accordance with the relevantprovisions.
A _____ is a reservation slip issued by the carriers to inform the exporter of the particulars of shipmentarrangement after shipping space is booked.
To pass through the _____ without declaration, the inbound passengers must not carry dutiable orprohibited items.
If the total Customs value does not exceed NT$12,000, samples carried by inbound passengers may begranted duty _____.
Any exported products shall be marked itself or on its internal and external package with the _____ in aconspicuous and durable manner.
To support trade promotion activities, the trade promotion service fee has been charged at the rate of0.04% on the _____ value of imports.

The addressee shall file for Customs clearance within 15 days from the day he receives a notice from thepostal authority to complete the Customs examination procedure when _____ value exceeds theequivalent of US$5,000.
An applicant, submitting _____ documents for an advance ruling on Customs valuation, shall remedysuch document within 30 days.
Duty and taxes on raw materials for export goods to be offset or refunded are limited to import duty,commodity tax and _____.
Which of the following goods are prohibited from storing in bonded warehouses?
opts: Parts and components of used vehicles, scrap iron, and scrap metal
Materials for repairing containers or pallets
Goods for inspection, sorting, segmentation, assembly, or reloading

mcq.q: The collecting agencies of the tobacco and alcohol taxes shall collect the _____ on tobacco productsalong with the taxes.
_____ is a profit-making enterprise that participates in the import and export cargo Customs clearanceand tariff payment processing agency operations.
Every registered freight forwarder shall provide Customs with a _____.
Declarations for import and export express _____ shall be online transmitted to Customs via a through-Customs value-added network.
A _____ bill of lading signifies that the goods received by the shipping company for shipment on boarda named vessel are in perfect condition.
Passengers are required to declare to the Customs if they are carrying cash in New Taiwan dollars in a(an) _____ value exceeding NT$100,000.
_____ is an electronic seal without embedded active transmitter for wireless communication and no signalis transmitted actively.
A global recession is on us and experts believe COVID-19 could drag world economy into a _____.
Regulations regarding clearance and management of importation and exportation under Customs Actshall apply mutatis mutandis to _____ of transshipment and transited goods.
In order to protect local _____ development, it is forbidden to import the flora and fauna from specificareas or for certain amounts.
For containers under Customs escort transportation placed in different Customs district, the escorttransportation fee shall be assessed based on the _____ of the escort transportation.
This is the first known case of an inmate _____ in the federal prison system to contract the disease.
An applicant may apply to the inspection authority for a re-inspection at no cost within 15 days afterreceiving a (an) _____ inspection notice.
Customs personnel shall keep _____ all information transmitted through the Customs-Port-Trade (CPT)Single Window.
